company.description:
At Sizekick, we are putting an end to unnecessary size-related returns in online fashion retail. We use artificial intelligence and computer vision technology to recommend the right clothing size. With the help of Sizekick’s integrated software, everyone can find their correct size on our partner shops in just a few seconds with a smartphone. The environment will thank us too, because for each saved return approx. 500 g of CO2 emissions are saved.

Our international team is growing and we have several interesting open positions. Please check out our career page. We would love to get to know you.
